Back in Black is the seventh studio album by the Australian hard rock band AC/DC, released on July 25, 1980, by Albert Productions and Atlantic Records.

Back in Black —en español: De vuelta de negro— es el séptimo álbum de estudio de la banda australiana de hard rock AC/DC, publicado el 25 de julio de 1980 por Albert Productions y Atlantic Records.
